hints.title: Monotonicity Property
hints.text: If a minimum gap target is feasible, any smaller gap is also feasible. This monotonicity permits binary searching over the minimum difference score.

hints.title: Greedy Leftmost Placement
hints.text: Sort the starting points. To maximize the chance of satisfying gap target, place each consecutive number at the earliest possible coordinate at or after previous plus target.

hints.title: Range Feasibility Check
hints.text: For each interval [start[i], start[i] + d], compute next coordinate as max(start[i], prev + target). If this coordinate exceeds start[i] + d, the target gap cannot be achieved.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n). Each binary search feasibility test checks n ranges in O(n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive selection across continuous or discrete interval values leads to exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sorting uses O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies binary search on the answer combined with greedy verification.
